" ) def create_user_profile(user_name: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML snippet containing the user's profile. Args: user_name (str): The user's full name. biography (str): A multi-sentence biography provided by the user. status (str): The user's current brief status update. Returns: str: A string containing the sanitized and formatted user profile ready to be embedded in a web page. Raises: ValueError: If any of the arguments are not strings. """ # Basic type checking if not isinstance(user_name, str): raise ValueError("user_name must be a string") if not isinstance(biography, str): raise ValueError("biography must be a string") if not isinstance(status, str): raise ValueError("status must be a string") # Escape user-supplied content to neutralize potential XSS payloads safe_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, biography=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
